title: 90 airlines for the A321LR! RMStudios livery mega pack | MSFS 2020
description:
Are you looking to expand your virtual hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator this week, or are you trying to avoid impulse buys on the storefront? Following the recent arrival of the Airbus A321LR in MSFS 2020, airline customization takes center stage in today's Marketplace update as we inspect a massive global repaint bundle.

To help you decide what fits your flight routine and budget, we take a closer look at this new Marketplace release and detail what the developer brings to the platform:

RMStudios A321LR Megapack Liveries: Expand your international route network with a collection of 90 airline liveries for the Airbus A321 Long Range. Covering carriers across nearly every corner of the globe, this bundle includes recognizable operators such as Air Canada Rouge, Azul, Iberia, Etihad, Batavia Air, Delta, Norwegian Air, Asiana, JetBlue, SKY Airline, Jet2holidays, and Air Arabia. Please note that you must own the base Airbus A321LR aircraft to use these liveries.

Whether you are planning transatlantic hops or regional trunk routes in the A321LR, we evaluate this ramp inspection to help you decide if this bundle deserves a spot in your simulator installation.

If you enjoy honest, clear, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below! Which airline are you flying first if you pick up this package?
